title: 第一卷 第89章 通天建木保送大帝第一卷 第88章 九字秘法证道契机
slug: 开局自曝系统家族助我娶妻成仙
lines: 通天建木！
一时间，不仅是姜临天，就连他身后的白霓裳都忍不住露出了惊讶的表情，快步凑了上来。
“这股气息，这滂沱的生命力，还有孕育其中的天地法则……”
“莫非，这是传说中的通天建木？”
白霓裳忍不住小嘴微张，下意识的伸手去触碰。
可手伸到一半，又怯生生的缩了回去。
姜临天忍不住揉了揉眼睛，脸上满是精彩之色。
“的确是通天建木，传说中的世界树……”
“无痕，此物太过珍贵，咱们立刻前往祖地，交由老祖定夺！”
他抓住姜无痕的肩膀，表情无比凝重。
临走前，他回头看了白霓裳一眼，无奈扶额：“赶紧回去把衣服换了，当着小辈的面衣衫不整，这成何体统？”
“怪我咯？”
白霓裳耸了耸肩，一脸无辜道：“还不是你昨夜太粗暴……”
她美眸流转，目光落在姜无痕身上，露出饶有兴致的神色。
“帝子，我那四位徒儿……可还满意？”
“她们虽然年纪尚轻，但都是经过我悉心调教的，会的花样……可一点都不比我少呢！”
白霓裳咯咯轻笑，千娇百媚，风情万种。
“白前辈，她们四位……暂时作为我的贴身侍女，尚且是清白之身。”
姜无痕淡然道。
“哦？那太可惜了……”
白霓裳轻笑，神秘兮兮的道：“不过，如果哪天帝子对她们感兴趣了，她们绝对不会让帝子失望的……”
“咳咳，正事要紧！”
姜临天轻咳一声，带着姜无痕离去。
白霓裳眸光微动，看向了殿外的雪姨，嘴角勾起一抹浅笑：“阿雪，好久不见……”
“如果没什么其他事的话，我们……聊聊吧？”
雪姨犹豫片刻后，点头走进了寝殿。
姜家祖地。
当姜无痕将通天建木幼苗拿到老祖们面前时，整个祖地都沸腾了。
“通天建木，这是通天建木！”
“小无痕，这玩意儿……哪来的？”
“还能是哪来的，肯定是天道垂赐！”
“当初老祖我要是有这玩意儿，又何必跟那群老家伙斗得你死我活，耗去了家族三分之一的底蕴……”
“都过去的事情了，小无痕，你知道……这株通天建木，意味着什么吗？”
五位老祖将姜无痕围在中间，满脸激动。
“我只知道这通天建木又被称作世界树，可孕育世界本源，对证道成帝有所帮助！”
姜无痕直截了当的开口，坦言道：“除此之外，我就不清楚了。”
几位老祖相视一眼，姜齐天的脸上，露出了回忆之色。
“传说中……诞生于混沌之中的先天神木，天地初开之际，第一株建木扎根于万界，撑起了诸天！”
“凡是建木所在的世界，法则完善，灵气充裕，界内修士的修行速度，相比于寻常世界，将提升百倍不止！”
“更重要的是……”
content_en:
Tongtian Jianmu!
For a moment, not only Jiang Lintian, but also Bai Nishang behind him couldn't help but show a surprised expression and quickly came closer.
"This breath, this torrential vitality, and the laws of heaven and earth that breed it..."
"Could it be that this is the legendary Tongtian Jianmu?"
Bai Nishang couldn't help but open her mouth slightly, and subconsciously reached out to touch it.
But when he reached halfway, he retracted timidly.
Jiang Lintian couldn't help but rub his eyes, his face full of excitement.
"It is indeed the Tongtian Jianmu, the legendary world tree..."
"Wuhen, this item is too precious. Let's go to the ancestral land immediately and let the ancestor decide!"
He grabbed Jiang Wuhen's shoulders, his expression extremely solemn.
Before leaving, he looked back at Bai Nishang and held his forehead helplessly: "Hurry back and change your clothes. How is it inappropriate to be disheveled in front of this junior?"
"Is it my fault?"
Bai Nishang shrugged and said innocently: "It's not that you were too rough last night..."
Her beautiful eyes turned, and her gaze fell on Jiang Wuhen, showing an interesting look.
"Emperor, are my four disciples...satisfied?"
"Although they are still young, they have been carefully trained by me, and their skills... are no less than mine!"
Bai Nishang chuckled, charming and charming.
"Senior Bai, the four of them... are temporarily serving as my personal maids, and they are still innocent."
Jiang Wuhen said calmly.
"Oh? That's such a pity..."
Bai Nishang chuckled and said mysteriously: "However, if the emperor is interested in them one day, they will never let him down..."
"Ahem, business matters!"
Jiang Lintian coughed lightly and left with Jiang Wuhen.
Bai Nishang's eyes moved slightly, and she looked at Aunt Xue outside the hall, with a slight smile on her lips: "Axue, long time no see..."
"If there's nothing else, let's... talk?"
After Aunt Xue hesitated for a moment, she nodded and walked into the bedroom.
…
The ancestral land of the Jiang family.
When Jiang Wuhen brought the Tongtian Jianmu seedlings to the ancestors, the entire ancestral land was boiling.
"Tongtian Jianmu, this is Tongtian Jianmu!"
"Xiao Wuhen, where did this thing... come from?"
"Where else could it come from? It must be a gift from heaven!"
"If my ancestor and I had this thing, why would I have to fight to the death with those old guys and consume one-third of the family's wealth..."
"It's all in the past, Xiao Wuhen, do you know... what does this tree that reaches the sky mean?"
The five ancestors surrounded Jiang Wuhen with excitement on their faces.
"I only know that this tree that reaches the sky is also called the World Tree. It can nurture the origin of the world and help to achieve enlightenment and become an emperor!"
Jiang Wuhen spoke straightforwardly and said frankly: "Other than that, I don't know."
Several ancestors looked at each other, and Jiang Qitian's face showed a look of memories.
"According to legend...the innate sacred tree was born in chaos. When the world first opened, the first tree took root in all realms and held up the heavens!"
"Any world where Jianmu is located has perfect laws and abundant spiritual energy. The cultivation speed of monks in the world will be more than a hundred times faster than that in the ordinary world!"
"More importantly..."
